Hi Alex / Priya —

Thanks again for the time on our call this morning. Per our discussion, I pulled together a short 30-minute walkthrough focused on inference economics and latency for your use case (customer personalization at scale). I attached a proposed agenda and a short capabilities one-pager.

Proposed slots:
- Tue 25 Nov, 10:00-10:30 PT
- Wed 26 Nov, 2:00-2:30 PT

If those don't work, tell me a couple of windows next week and we'll flex. Goal: show a targeted demo, answer integration questions, and propose next steps (pilot scope + MA).

Thanks,
Jonas

From: Priya Sharma <priya.sharma@solrise.com>

Date: Wed, 03 Dec 2025 16:42:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Intro + demo — quick 30m?

Hi Jonas / Marissa —

Quick update from our side: after the product leadership meetup last week, we’re reprioritizing work for Q1. The personalization/inference initiative is being deprioritized in favor of core data platform stabilization and a merchant onboarding push. That means we won't be able to commit engineering time for a pilot in the near term.

We still think Redwood's approach looks promising, but for now we need to park the demo and revisit in late Q1 / early Q2. Apologies for the back-and-forth — product calendar got compressed.

Can we do two things while this is parked?
1) Keep a short email thread with recommended follow-ups we can pick up later (pilot template, cost reference points).
2) Schedule a 30-min check-in for mid-Feb — we can firm up timing then.

Thanks,
Priya
VP, Product Operations, Solrise
priya.sharma@solrise.com

From: Jonas Weber <jonas@redwood.com>
To: Priya Sharma <priya.sharma@solrise.com>, Alex Zhou <alex@solrise.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>, Soojin Lee <soojin@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 04 Dec 2025 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Solrise inference demo — timeline update and next steps

Hi Priya / Alex —

Totally understand — thanks for the transparency and the context. We'll mark the opportunity as "parked" in our pipeline and leave a lightweight follow-up plan:

- Marissa will prepare a one-page pilot template (scope, minimal infra, estimated token cost) and a short checklist for audit/security items.
- Soojin will add a cost/reference slide comparing Dedicated vs Hosted for the expected QPS and sequence lengths you described.
- I'll tentatively set a calendar placeholder for Feb 16–20, 2026 and we'll sync closer to that week.

If anything changes sooner (capacity freed, a smaller scoped proof-of-concept), ping me and we can stand up a short demo in a week. Appreciate the candid update — we'll stay in touch.

Best,
Jonas
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
jonas@redwood.com
